scope: Compare all supplied findings with the current implementation and correct outstanding issues; packaging remains separate.

findings.change: Defaults/example disabled; provider URLs empty; no public demo fallback URLs.

findings.finding: Login throttle counts successful logins and locks global usernames
findings.change: Failures only, per-IP and per-IP/username buckets; no global username bucket.
Flush generic response/session, atomically queue private job, launch bounded CLI delivery; preserve newer token on older failure.
Canonical versioned manage function for API and CLI; pending applications cannot be disabled.
Password dialog with localized recovery link and own-session list/revocation; failed input retained.

findings.finding: Unused tracking control/history and routes get HTTP actions
findings.change: CLI-only simulation control retained; SQL history/pruning and internal route reads preserved.
Shared server-rendered saved/public locale and Content-Language; public picker no hardcoded Spanish.
Core Request::version used by all affected consumers.
All 25 pages send CSP frame-ancestors 'self' and X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN.
Exact original font bytes/descriptors mirrored locally, with licenses and provenance.
Five failures per user/source over 15 minutes, then 429/Retry-After.

findings.finding: Pending/disabled staff pages return raw JSON
findings.change: Existing 303 redirect behavior retained; explicit pending/disabled regressions added.

mail_checks: Slow loopback mock verifies prompt generic 202 and a free web worker.
Owner-only private jobs, matching recipient, single delivery and file cleanup.
Failed older background send cannot revoke a newer credential.
Existing expiry, replacement, revocation and reset/audit contracts preserved.

visual_comparison.comparison_regions: Port-specific link/QR contents and live remote map tiles excluded; geometry and styles retained. Original dropdown exclusions retained.

measurement.vendor_exclusion: Vendor font binaries, CSS profiles, licenses/provenance are excluded from first-party counts; original artwork is unchanged.

limitations: Real provider configuration/inbox delivery remains unverified; tests use a loopback mock.
Executable PHP CLI and proc_open required for background mail; eventual Apache-user deployment remains to be checked.
Existing public map tile requests/fallbacks remain; disabling address lookup does not make map tiles offline.
Phone checks use Chromium emulation, not physical devices/Safari.
No submission archive produced; original private data/configuration and global Apache settings unchanged.
